verification_boundary: Synthetic 80k RF carrying independently decoded public 72k image content. The native-C transport reference sees ideal transmitted bits, while the actual app receives independently pulse-shaped impaired RF samples. Original off-air 80k and physical/field release gates remain unverified.
reference_limits: The unmodified old meteor_decode CLI -i -d reports zero MPDUs because its differential stage is pre-Viterbi per-quadrature, unlike modern m2x_mode post-Viterbi NRZ-M. The successful separate adapter uses its unmodified native transport primitives with the independently documented modern convention. It decodes ideal transmitted bits, not impaired RF; application RF output is compared to that independently decoded data and Pillow/libjpeg images.
